final_sql:
SELECT AirportCode
FROM (
    SELECT a.AirportCode,
           COALESCE(d.dept,0) + COALESCE(r.arr,0) AS total_flights
    FROM airports a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT SourceAirport, COUNT(*) AS dept
        FROM flights
        GROUP BY SourceAirport
    ) d ON a.AirportCode = d.SourceAirport
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DestAirport, COUNT(*) AS arr
        FROM flights
        GROUP BY DestAirport
    ) r ON a.AirportCode = r.DestAirport
) sub
WHERE total_flights = (
    SELECT MIN(total_flights) FROM (
        SELECT COALESCE(d.dept,0) + COALESCE(r.arr,0) AS total_flights
        FROM airports a
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT SourceAirport, COUNT(*) AS dept
            FROM flights
            GROUP BY SourceAirport
        ) d ON a.AirportCode = d.SourceAirport
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DestAirport, COUNT(*) AS arr
            FROM flights
            GROUP BY DestAirport
        ) r ON a.AirportCode = r.DestAirport
    )
)
gold_sql: SELECT T1.AirportCode FROM AIRPORTS AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode  =  T2.DestAirport OR T1.AirportCode  =  T2.SourceAirport GROUP BY T1.AirportCode ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1

final_sql:
SELECT name
FROM Highschooler
WHERE ID IN (
  SELECT student_id
  FROM Likes
  GROUP BY student_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
      SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM Likes
      GROUP BY student_id
    )
  )
)
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

final_sql:
SELECT o.owner_id, o.last_name
FROM Owners o
JOIN Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id
JOIN Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.last_name
ORDER BY COUNT(t.treatment_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
